none: PAS BH-9738D9: Roman coin: nummus of Constantine I
contea di ritrovamento: Buckinghamshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy Roman nummus of Constantine I, dating to AD 336 (Reece period 17). Obverse depicts a rosette diademed, draped and cuirassed bust right. Reverse depicts two soldiers standing holding spear and shield, between them is one standard. Reverse inscription GLORIA EXERCITVS. Mint of Lyon. Diameter is 15.75mm, thickness is 1.4mm and weight is 1.7g. Reference RIC Vol VII pg 141, no. 280
